method: All original RNA FASTQ pairs; exact31mer forward/reverse matches against both alleles, high-quality filters over every marker base; no genomic mapping requirement; collapse every pair to allele presence, disqualify cross-allele conflicts for exclusive counts. No UMI or PCR molecule inference.
limits: RNA arises from both malignant and nonmalignant cells; presence does not establish tumor retention, genomic copy number, protein presentation, or vaccine efficacy.
Two-field specificity limited to observed sequences in IMGT3.46.0, including partial records, and GENCODE37.
Diagnostic-marker opportunities differ substantially between alleles; raw pair ratios are not calibrated allele abundance.
Distinct paired read sequences are not independently labeled molecules; FFPE/library artifacts and unrepresented alleles remain possible.
